audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Append-only, hash-chained record of every material action.
audit.head: Head hash
audit.empty: No audit events match these filters.
audit.adminOnlyBody: The audit trail is restricted to administrators. Ask a workspace administrator for audit access.
audit.explain: Each event stores the previous hash and its own SHA-256 hash. Editing or deleting a row breaks verification.

graph.title: Supply-chain graph
graph.subtitle: Company, suppliers, risks, obligations, and internal policies in one view.
graph.select: Select a node to inspect it
graph.clickHint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a node
graph.source: Graph projection from the operational Postgres database. Neo4j is not wired in this pilot.

evals.title: Evaluations
evals.subtitle: A golden set for extraction, citation, verification, and language safety.
evals.gateCitation: Every risk must cite source text
evals.gateVerifier: Verifier must accept or flag for review
evals.stackBody: Configured stack: Gemini Flash for extraction, Groq GPT-OSS for classification, and Gemini Pro for verification, with automatic fallback. The hosted pilot runs deterministic mock mode.
evals.restricted: Evaluations require analyst or admin access.

search.title: Evidence search
search.subtitle: Hybrid retrieval across cited source chunks. Find the exact language behind a risk.
search.startBody: Every result is a source chunk with a citation, not a generated answer.
search.howBody: Chunks are embedded and indexed in Postgres with pgvector, combined with full-text search, then ranked. Mock embeddings are the verified path; BGE-M3 and reranking are optional and not on the hosted path.
